## Who is Muhammad Ali Ghias?
Muhammad Ali Ghias (also known as Ali Ghias, Ghias, MAG, and ali-ghiax) is a Software Engineer and Graphic Designer based in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. He is the Lead Microsoft Learn Student Ambassador (MLSA) and Campus Lead for the MLSA CUSIT Chapter at City University of Science & Information Technology (CUSIT). He is also the founder of Cyber Tools, a free online utilities platform.

## Core facts
- Profession: Software Engineer and Graphic Designer
- Focus areas: full-stack web development, Microsoft technologies, cloud/Azure learning, brand and logo design
- Education affiliation: City University of Science & Information Technology (CUSIT), Peshawar
- Languages: English, Urdu, Pashto
- Availability: open to full-time, freelance, and collaboration opportunities

## Leadership and community
- Lead Microsoft Learn Student Ambassador / Campus Lead, MLSA CUSIT Chapter
- Built and grew the MLSA CUSIT student community through workshops, mentoring, and campus tech initiatives
- Guest speaker at Northern University (Mar 2026) covering how to become a Microsoft Learn Student Ambassador
- Conducted a Microsoft Technologies seminar at CUSIT (Feb 2026) for 60+ students; received Certificate and Shield of Appreciation
